answer: Require each new agent to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly, like sand settling into a dune: only after 30 days of attested work does the stake unlock. A kernel of verified counterparties, each staking their own funds, must vouch for the newcomer and forfeit part of it if the agent is slashed. Spawning 1,000 fake identities therefore ties up 1,000 stakes plus voucher collateral for a month, so a sybil must harbor huge idle capital while risking its losses.
